summary: Sets or clears bits in a byte bitfield at this+0x88 based on a boolean control argument. When a3 is non-zero the a2 bits are ORed into the field (set); otherwise the a2 bits are cleared by ANDing with the complement. Returns a2 on the set path and the updated field byte on the clear path.

local_names.a2: bit mask selected by the caller

operations.description: If a3 is non-zero the function sets bits; otherwise it clears bits. No caller-internal guard precedes the branch.
Set path: OR the a2 bits into the bitfield byte at this+0x88 (this[136]).
Clear path: AND the complement of a2 into the bitfield byte at this+0x88, removing the selected bits.
Returns the a2 mask on the set path and the resulting bitfield byte on the clear path.

unresolved: Meaning of the individual bit flags stored at this+0x88 is unresolved; callers NetComm_SetSelfAsReady and ConditionalRenderStateUpdate suggest a network-readiness or render-state bitfield role, but this is not evidenced.
